    Deck shifts on invariant object-deletion quotients #

    An intermediate covering stage deletes a union of orbits for the subgroup Γ. This file supplies exactly the symmetry retained by such a stage. An action-invariant, isomorphism-closed deleted set is invariant under the coherent deck shifts, so the shifts descend through C/(S). The literal deck action on surviving objects and the descended shifts again form a CoherentDeckShift.
